name: 自然火焰 + 飘升箭头
notice: 大招就绪的火焰去掉硬描边，改成真实火焰的不规则跳动边缘；火里的 ^^ 箭头像火星一样往上飘、变小、消散。包含 0.8.5 的 P5 预告信结算页和「队长 ⇄」徽章。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 WebGL R131: Fx1023Spire noise-eroded soft fire edge with wisps (no ink/rim lines), flame-tongue disc rim instead of a ring, eased swaying chevrons (3 in flight).

validation.iosSimulator: 2-4: ready flame wraps the disc with a ragged edge and no outline; chevrons drift up, shrink and fade.

knownLimits: 没有头像的成员（如夕璃）在拍立得里显示的是缩小的全身立绘。
